subject: Acme POC kickoff - recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC kickoff - recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking time to run through the pilot scope today - great conversation. Quick recap so we all have the same expectations and next steps. Please reply if I missed anything.

Pain points you called out:
- Erratic latency on your current hosted endpoints during peak traffic (p95 spikes > 800ms).
- High per-token inference costs that make AI features uneconomical for low-margin products.
- Inconsistent embedding quality across product catalogs leading to poor search/recommendation relevance.

Pilot goals (agreed):
1) Validate that Redwood can meet p95 latency < 300ms for your chat endpoint under 100 rps simulated load.
2) Reduce per-1k token inference cost by >= 30% vs current baseline (we'll baseline from your July traffic sample).
3) Improve top-5 embedding retrieval relevance by 10 points on your evaluation set.

Scope & timeline:
- Duration: 4 weeks (pilot), starting after we get lab access and sample data - target kickoff week of 7/5.
- Workstreams: infra/setup (VPC + creds), model selection & quantization profile, prompt set & eval harness, monitoring & SLO verification, handoff to your product team.

Owners:
- Redwood AM: Marissa Cole (me) - overall program owner, SOW coordination.
- Redwood SE: Rafael Mendes - integration, perf tuning, evals.
- Acme PM: John Doe - data owner, provides sample prompts & eval labels.
- Acme Ops: Susan Lee - networking/procurement.

Access/setup items we need from you to hit the 7/5 kickoff target:
1) Service account for Redwood with scoped access or a pre-created API key (preferred) - contact: susan.lee@acme.com to coordinate.
2) Short sample dataset: ~500 representative queries + expected relevance labels (CSV) and a small product catalog export.
3) Network requirements: VPC peering details or allowlisted egress IPs for Redwood test agents (we can provide IPs once we have your VPC range).
4) Security questionnaire points we flagged for faster review: SOC 2 evidence & data retention policy; I attached our security summary.

Deliverables we will produce:
- SOW/statement of work draft (attached: acme_sow_draft.pdf)
- Pilot runbook (integration steps + test harness)
- Weekly checkpoints with perf dashboards and eval results

Next immediate steps (this week):
- John/Susan: confirm service account method and share sample dataset by 7/2 EOD.
- Acme security: review attached redwood-security-sheet.pdf and flag any blocker.
- Redwood: finalize SOW draft and send for review by 7/2.

Thanks - Rafael and I will be on standby for a short kickoff meeting once access is ready.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: acme_sow_draft.pdf, redwood-security-sheet.pdf, acme_sample_prompts.csv

From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>

Cc: Susan Lee <susan.lee@acme.com>, Acme Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff - recap & next steps

Marissa - thanks for the thorough recap. All of this looks right from our side. Quick notes: 
- We can provide the sample dataset by EOD 7/2 - I'll assign it to our data analyst.
- For access, we'd prefer the service account method; Susan will follow up with our infra team to share the proper IAM role.
- Security team: I'll loop them in; they may request the SOC 2 Type II report. If you can share the latest SOC evidence, that would help speed review.

Confirming kickoff window of 7/5 works for our team. Rafael - can you confirm expected agent IP ranges so our networking can open them?

Cheers,
John
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
john.doe@acme.com

- For embeddings, please include a sample of the edge-case products (long descriptions, legacy SKUs) so we can validate retrieval quality.

Neha - pinging you on the SOC 2 evidence request John mentioned. Can you share the latest Type II report or point them to the secure share?

Marissa - I'll take the lead on the eval harness and send the initial script + instructions to John once we have the dataset.
